# Fizz Kidz

> Fizz Kidz is an Australian children's entertainment provider offering hosted birthday parties, school holiday programs, preschool sessions, school programs and event activations. Its seven public studios are in Balwyn, Cheltenham, Essendon, Geelong, Kingsville, Malvern and Werribee, Victoria.

Fizz Kidz runs hands-on activities for children, including slime, science, art, craft, tie dye and take-home creations. Birthday parties and holiday programs are generally designed for children aged 4 to 12. Current availability, pricing and booking details should be confirmed on the official pages linked below.

## Main Services

- [Kids birthday parties](https://www.fizzkidz.com.au/birthday-parties/): Hosted themed parties at Fizz Kidz studios.
- [At-home birthday parties](https://www.fizzkidz.com.au/birthday-parties/at-home-parties/): Mobile parties at a customer's home or venue.
- [School holiday programs](https://www.fizzkidz.com.au/holiday-programs/): Creative programs during Victorian school holidays.
- [Preschool program](https://www.fizzkidz.com.au/preschool-program/): Art, science and sensory sessions for children aged 2.5 to 5.
- [School science incursions](https://www.fizzkidz.com.au/in-schools/incursions/): Hands-on science sessions delivered at schools.
- [Event activations](https://www.fizzkidz.com.au/activations-and-events/): Children's activities for community, shopping centre and corporate events.
